notes.title: Mountain Tales - Kickstarter Announcement
notes.notes:
🏔️⛏️💎Get ready to dive into the world of Arafinn with this exclusive cinematic teaser for the brand-new comic book series "Mountain Tales". 🏔️

[previewyoutube=hcdmd8s60rU;full][/previewyoutube]

This video offers a sneak peek into the grim, mystical realm of Arafinn, setting the stage for the epic quest of our protagonists, Duorìn Shadowstone, the seasoned dwarven alchemist, and his unwavering companion Finrim Stonehand. Join them as they navigate through the treacherous terrains, untold perils, and hidden secrets of this dark world, on a formidable journey to unravel the essence of immortality itself.

🏔️⛏️ "Mountain Tales" isn't your average comic book series; It's a dwarven comic brought up from the very depths of the mines. It weaves a captivating narrative, combined with striking, intricate artistry, immersing readers into a dark universe filled with suspense, mystery, and adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41302302/69ddaf6a0c2fb5bbac65b4f2d2d22687268c7963.jpg[/img]

📅 Stay tuned for the full-length cinematic, set to premiere on launch day of our Kickstarter campaign. Every frame is carefully crafted to breathe life into the characters and their saga, teasing the depth and richness of the world you'll be exploring in the comic series.

🍻 Intrigued? Be a part of this journey. Your support on Kickstarter will help bring Mountain Tales to life.

⛏️ Let's begin this incredible journey together and bring "Mountain Tales" to life!

notes.title: The Arafinn Kontor demo now on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hi there!

We've got fantastic news to share! As part of this year’s Steam Next Fest, we’re releasing the Demo for the ARAFINN KONTOR! 

What’s the Arafinn Kontor you might ask? Well, the Arafinn Kontor is your main hub to the Arafinn Experience where you’ll be able to read interactive short stories, comics, explore a satellite view world map of Arafinn, read wikis about families and creatures and learn the 4 main languages of Arafinn through online dictionaries. With our upcoming game Return to Nangrim, this will be the perfect place to immerse yourself in the lore of its universe.

All of these features will be gradually extended with new content and lore over time. 

Don’t miss the Arafinn Kontor, try it out now! You can download it and wishlist it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1707970/Arafinn_Kontor/

Have fun exploring!
